svg.title: Management and monitoring in the Azure landing zone
svg.desc: Own layout of the Management design area. Three columns for the operations baseline: inventory and visibility (central Log Analytics workspace, Azure Monitor, resource locks, deny policies), operational compliance (Azure Update Manager, Azure Policy and Machine Configuration for drift), protect and recover (Azure Backup, Azure Site Recovery, availability zones). Bottom band: platform monitoring, where policy initiatives assigned at management groups deploy alert rules, alert processing rules and action groups. Icons are official Azure icons.
svg.text: Management design area: the operations baseline
Inventory and visibility
Where logs go, who sees them, who is told
Central logging
One workspace for the platform, unless RBAC,
sovereignty or retention need more; teams may add their own
Export to Azure Storage beyond seven years
Guardrails
Azure Policy for access control and compliance
Deny policies supplement role assignments
Resource locks on critical shared services
Also recommended
Service health and resource health events

Data born in Azure stays in Azure

Operational compliance
Patching and configuration drift

Azure Site Recovery

ExpressRoute in multiple regions and peering locations
Avoid overlapping IP ranges
Between production and disaster recovery networks
Monitor the platform landing zone: baseline alerts deployed by Azure Policy
Intermediate root management group
Service health and notifications assets
initiatives, reaching all subscriptions
Platform management groups
Connectivity, identity and management
initiatives
Landing zones management group
Landing zone initiative
Deployed when a resource is created
DeployIfNotExists effect
Alert rules, processing rules, groups
Components with baseline alerts: ExpressRoute, Azure Firewall, Virtual Network, Virtual WAN, Log Analytics workspace,
Private DNS zone, Key Vault, Virtual Machine, Storage account.
At least one action group per subscription, with at least an email channel. Test alerts before production.
Out of scope for this design area: advanced operations, tech platform operations and workload operations.
